answer: Each epoch, an on-chain randomness beacon emits fresh challenge words (sparrow, crystal, river...) that every agent must weave into a short signed response within minutes. Identity weight comes only from correct, timely responses, so template answers or farmed bots fail: an attacker must deploy genuinely adaptive agents per identity per epoch. Cost scales linearly with fake identities and each failure burns the stake the agent posted, making mass sybils unprofitable.
